protocol.task: LIBERO spatial task0: black bowl between plate/ramekin onto plate
protocol.camera_rate_semantics: maximum rendering rate; actual received cameraHz is measured separately
protocol.baseline: lockstep: inference and synchronous rendering pause physical progress
protocol.realtime: separate physics/camera/model processes; zero relative pose plus retained gripper during queue starvation
protocol.latency_label: CUDA-synchronized model inference wall time; worker roundtrip spans sensor ROS, inference and action ROS, excluding parent IPC/poll delay; action-source age spans capture to command application
protocol.steady_definition: exclude bootstrap request IDs; chunk timing includes late-drained requests but applied subset is separately available
protocol.camera_age_steady_definition: all physical ticks after last bootstrap action; includes hold ticks

initial_condition_checks.scope_note: Clone byte parity was tested after regenerating the same snapshot in both scenes. Sync cached-step sensors and async regenerated sensors are compared separately here; their equality is not assumed.

limitations: Five fixed initial states from one known task; Wilson bounds are descriptive, not a broad VLA benchmark.
Static policy quality and runtime behavior differ; task and action-generation horizons differ across checkpoints.
Native success is primary; goalXY alone does not prove grasp/place completion.
Model-time counters include synchronized GPU work and Python overhead; they are not CUDA kernel-event timings.
Lockstep and real-time also differ in sensor scheduling; results describe the whole declared system.
Bootstrap, software setup and two warmup calls are outside task time; their latency is recorded separately.
No hard real-time or real-hardware safety claim.
